src/metrics/zones.rs.description: ZoneTracker has cadence zone tracking with set_cadence_zones(), update_cadence() (with debounce and CadenceZoneChange events), current_cadence_zone(), and current_cadence_zone_name() methods following the same pattern as HR zone tracking.

src/metrics/calculator.rs.description: MetricsCalculator::process() now calculates cadence_zone when cadence_zones is set, following the same pattern as power_zone and hr_zone calculation. The zone is calculated using zones.get_zone(cadence) when cadence_rpm is present in the SensorReading.

src/ui/widgets/zone_indicator.rs.description: zone_badge() now accepts ZoneType enum (Power, HeartRate, Cadence) instead of is_power bool. ZoneType is exported from widgets module. This enables compact zone badge rendering for all three zone types with correct colors.
